verses.saheeh: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
verses.khattab: As for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺, it is they who will be successful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then those whose scales are heavy, with good deeds, they are the successful, the winners;

verses.uthmani: وَمَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ فِي جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِيْنُهٗ فَاُولٰۤٮِٕكَ الَّذِيْنَ خَسِرُوْۤا اَنْفُسَهُمْ فِىْ جَهَـنَّمَ خٰلِدُوْنَۚ
verses.transliteration: waman khaffat mawazeenuhu faolaika allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fee jahannama khalidoona
verses.saheeh: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
verses.khattab: But those whose scale is light, they will have doomed themselves, staying in Hell forever
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and those whose scales are light, because of evil deeds, they are the ones who have lost their souls, and so they will be, abiding in Hell.

verses.uthmani: تَلۡفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ
verses.indopak: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوْهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيْهَا كٰلِحُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: talfahu wujoohahumu alnnaru wahum feeha kalihoona
verses.saheeh: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
verses.khattab: The Fire will burn their faces, leaving them deformed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The Fire will scorch their faces, it will burn them, while they glower therein, their upper and lower lips having receded from their teeth, and it will be said to them:

verses.uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.indopak: اَلَمْ تَكُنْ اٰيٰتِىْ تُتْلٰى عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: alam takun ayatee tutla 'alaykum fakuntum biha tukaththiboona
verses.saheeh: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
verses.khattab: ˹It will be said,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, but you used to deny them?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Were not My signs, in the Qur'an, recited to you, were you [not] threatened therewith, and you used to deny them?’

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتۡ عَلَيۡنَا شِقۡوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوۡمٗا ضَآلِّينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَاۤلِّيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qaloo rabbana ghalabat 'alayna shiqwatuna wakunna qawman dalleena
verses.saheeh: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
verses.khattab: They will cry, “Our Lord! Our ill-fate took hold of us, so we became a misguided people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They will say, ‘Our Lord, our wretchedness (shiqwatunā: a variant reading has shaqāwatunā, both of which are verbal nouns with the same meaning) overcame us, and we were an erring folk, [astray] from guidance.

verses.uthmani: رَبَّنَآ أَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡهَا فَإِنۡ عُدۡنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ
verses.indopak: رَبَّنَاۤ اَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَاِنْ عُدْنَا فَاِنَّا ظٰلِمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: rabbana akhrijna minha fain 'udna fainna thalimoona
verses.saheeh: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
verses.khattab: Our Lord! Take us out of this ˹Fire˺. Then if we ever return ˹to denial˺, we will truly be wrongdoers.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Our Lord, bring us out of it! Then, if we revert, to disobedience, we will indeed be evildoers’.

verses.uthmani: قَالَ ٱخۡسَـُٔواْ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
verses.indopak: قَالَ اخْسَـُٔـوْا فِيْهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُوْنِ
verses.transliteration: qala ikhsaoo feeha wala tukallimooni
verses.saheeh: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
verses.khattab: Allah will respond, “Be despised in there! Do not ˹ever˺ plead with Me ˹again˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He will say, to them by the tongue of a Keeper [of Hell], whose proportion is twice the size of this world: ‘Begone in it, away with you in the Fire, despicable [as you are], and do not speak to Me, about relieving you from the chastisement — so that [all] their hope is extinguished.

verses.uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡ عِبَادِي يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّهٗ كَانَ فَرِيْقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِىْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَـنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَاَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَۚ
verses.transliteration: innahu kana fareequn min 'ibadee yaqooloona rabbana amanna faighfir lana wairhamna waanta khayru alrrahimeena
verses.saheeh: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
verses.khattab: Indeed, there was a group of My servants who used to pray, ‘Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the best of those who show mercy,’
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed there was a party of My servants — namely, the Emigrants — who would say, “Our Lord, we believe; therefore forgive us, and have mercy on us, for You are the best of the merciful”.

verses.uthmani: فَٱتَّخَذۡتُمُوهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرِي وَكُنتُم مِّنۡهُمۡ تَضۡحَكُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوْهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتّٰۤى اَنْسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِىْ وَكُنْتُمْ مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: faittakhathtumoohum sikhriyyan hatta ansawkum thikree wakuntum minhum tadhakoona
verses.saheeh: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
verses.khattab: but you were ˹so busy˺ making fun of them that it made you forget My remembrance. And you used to laugh at them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But then you took them as an object of ridicule (read sukhriyyan or sikhriyyan, a verbal noun meaning ‘mockery’). Among those [ridiculed] were Bilāl [al-Habashī], Suhayb [al-Rūmī], ‘Ammār [b. Yāsir] and Salmān [al-Fārisī]; until they made you forget My remembrance, which you disregarded, as you were engaged in deriding them. Thus these [men] were the cause of the forgetting, which is why this [act] has been attributed to them, and you used to laugh at them.

verses.uthmani: إِنِّي جَزَيۡتُهُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡفَآئِزُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنِّىْ جَزَيْتُهُمُ الْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤاۙاَنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْفَاۤٮِٕزُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: innee jazaytuhumu alyawma bima sabaroo annahum humu alfaizoona
verses.saheeh: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
verses.khattab: Today I have indeed rewarded them for their perseverance: they are certainly the triumphant.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed I have rewarded them this day, abiding bliss, for the endurance they showed, while you mocked them and caused them hurt. They are indeed the winners’, of what they sought (read innahum as [indicating] a new sentence, or annahum as [indicating] a second direct object of the [verb] jazaytuhum, ‘I have rewarded them’).

verses.uthmani: قَٰلَ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
verses.indopak: قٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala kam labithtum fee alardi 'adada sineena
verses.saheeh: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
verses.khattab: He will ask ˹them˺, “How many years did you remain on earth?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, exalted be He, will say, to them by the tongue of a Keeper [of Hell] (a variant reading [for qāla, ‘He will say’] has qul, ‘say’): ‘How long did you tarry in the earth, in this world and in your graves, in years?’ (‘adada sinīna is a specification).

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا أَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡمٖ فَسۡـَٔلِ ٱلۡعَآدِّينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا اَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْــَٔـلِ الْعَاۤدِّيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qaloo labithna yawman aw ba'da yawmin faisali al'addeena
verses.saheeh: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
verses.khattab: They will reply, “We remained ˹only˺ a day or part of a day. But ask those who kept count.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They will say, ‘We tarried a day, or part of a day — they are uncertain thereof, deeming it shorter [than what it was] because of the gravity of the chastisement they are suffering. Yet ask those who keep count!’, namely, [ask] the angels who number the deeds of [all] creatures.

verses.uthmani: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗاۖلَّوۡ أَنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: قٰلَ اِنْ لَّبِثْـتُمْ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا لَّوْ اَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala in labithtum illa qaleelan law annakum kuntum ta'lamoona
verses.saheeh: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
verses.khattab: He will say, “You only remained for a little while, if only you knew
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, exalted, will say, to them, also by the tongue of Keeper [of Hell] (a variant reading [for qāla, ‘He will say’] has qul, ‘say’): ‘You tarried but a little, if only you knew, the length of time you tarried, [you would have realised that it is] trivial relative to how long you will tarry in the Fire.

verses.uthmani: أَفَحَسِبۡتُمۡ أَنَّمَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ عَبَثٗا وَأَنَّكُمۡ إِلَيۡنَا لَا تُرۡجَعُونَ
verses.indopak: اَفَحَسِبْتُمْ اَنَّمَا خَلَقْنٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَّاَنَّكُمْ اِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum 'abathan waannakum ilayna la turja'oona
verses.saheeh: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
verses.khattab: Did you then think that We had created you without purpose, and that you would never be returned to Us?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Did you suppose that We created you aimlessly, and not for an underlying reason, and that you would not be returned to Us?’ (read active tarji‘ūna, ‘you [would not] return’, or passive turja‘ūna, ‘you [would not] be returned’) Nay! But [it was] so that We might enthral you with commands and prohibitions, where after you would be returned to Us for Us to requite [you] accordingly: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except that they may worship Me [Q. 51:56].

verses.uthmani: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖلَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
verses.indopak: فَتَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَـقُّۚلَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۚرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْـكَرِيْمِ
verses.transliteration: fata'ala allahu almaliku alhaqqu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu al'arshi alkareemi
verses.saheeh: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
verses.khattab: Exalted is Allah, the True King! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, the Lord of the Honourable Throne
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So exalted be God, above aimless action and other such things that do not befit Him, the King, the Truth! There is no god except Him, the Lord of the Noble Throne (‘arsh), the throne (kursī), which is a seat [similar to a king’s] that is exquisite.

verses.uthmani: وَمَن يَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرۡهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓۚإِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَنْ يَّدْعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَۙلَا بُرْهَانَ لَهٗ بِهٖۙفَاِنَّمَا حِسَابُهٗ عِنْدَ رَبِّهٖۗاِنَّهٗ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْـكٰفِرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waman yad'u ma'a allahi ilahan akhara la burhana lahu bihi fainnama hisabuhu 'inda rabbihi innahu la yuflihu alkafiroona
verses.saheeh: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
verses.khattab: Whoever invokes, besides Allah, another god—for which they can have no proof—they will surely find their penalty with their Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will never succeed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And he who calls on another god along with God has no proof thereof (lā burhāna lahu bihi, an [extra] explicative adjectival qualification that has no [other syntactical] signification), his reckoning, his requital, will indeed be with his Lord. Truly the disbelievers will not be successful, they will not be felicitous.

verses.uthmani: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ وَٱرۡحَمۡ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَقُلْ رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَاَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَ٪
verses.transliteration: waqul rabbi ighfir wairham waanta khayru alrrahimeena
verses.saheeh: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And say: ‘My Lord, forgive and have mercy, on believers — [this] ‘mercy’ adds to the ‘forgiveness’ [in terms of God’s grace] — and You are the best of the merciful’, the most excellent of those who have mercy.
